miniProject.title: Paged KV allocator with prefix reuse
miniProject.brief: Extend `engine/` with a paged KV allocator, a prefix index with strict identity and a labeled CPU simulation of routing and offload. Prove ownership under churn and show where reuse helps goodput and where high hits mislead, for a model that fits your GPU.
steps: Describe per-layer KV state with byte accounting for dense, latent and hybrid cases in `engine/`, implement block-table translation with valid-length gathers, and prove permutation preserves positions checked against Nano-vLLM allocation views with ledgers kept in `reports/`.

Derive contiguous versus paged capacity with reserve and sharing in `engine/`, implement a reserve-aware private allocator with multi-token append and failure atomicity, checked by a separate logical ledger with histories kept in `reports/`.

Implement fork with partial-tail copy-on-write and beam-pruning histories checked against unshared copies, then eviction, recompute, cancellation and late-event rejection proving single release with traces kept in `reports/`.

Build block-hash lookup with exact verification under forced collisions and a radix longest-prefix index, checked with the TensorTonic trie problem plus a tenant, version and media identity matrix kept in `reports/`.

Port the Mini-SGLang allocation regression contracts to `tests/` and run randomized allocator and index histories against an independent oracle, shrinking failures and catching injected mutants with histories kept in `reports/`.

Simulate cache-aware routing and offload with versioned descriptors in `sim/` using labeled CPU costs, then measure reuse off and on with ablations showing one benefit and one high-hit non-improvement with fairness evidence in `reports/`, with an optional measured pair on your GPU.
deliverables: `engine/` paged allocator and prefix index with ownership, collision and scope tests.
Randomized state-machine suite in `tests/` with shrunk failures and mutant catches.
Routing and reuse report in `reports/` with benefit, high-hit negative and fairness evidence.

checks.name: TensorTonic Find Reusable Prefixes in KV Trie
checks.note: Solve the trie cases by hand first, then extend with collision checks.

checks.name: Mini-SGLang allocator regression suite
checks.note: Port the named contracts, then add randomized histories around them.

rubric.pass: Randomized fork, copy-on-write, eviction and cancellation histories match the unshared oracle with exact counts.
rubric.strong: Shrunk failures isolate the first bad transition and injected mutants are all caught.

rubric.pass: Constant-hash histories never return foreign state and the identity matrix rejects incompatible reuse.
rubric.strong: Partial-edge splits and eviction keep references consistent with brute-force agreement.

rubric.pass: Reuse off and on runs share arrivals and contracts with TTFT, goodput and fairness from traces.
rubric.strong: The high-hit negative names its overhead and the routing crossover is predicted before measurement.

miniProject.feedsInto: Allocator, index and reuse evidence feed scheduling, distribution and operations projects and the capstone contribution.
